'''Bentho's Nightclub''' was a location in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]] where seedy characters could get a drink. The club had a central bar area and a number of seats. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Duel in Bentho's Nightclub|chased]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Trenox]] there in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bentho's Nigthclub appears in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''.
